训练误差与测试误差
Chapter 8: Generalization

Page 104

This chapter discusses tools to analyze and understand the generalization of machine learning models, i.e, their performances on unseen test examples. Recall that for supervised learning problems, given a training dataset {(x(i),y(i))}i=1n​, we typically learn a model hθ​ by minimizing a loss/cost function J(θ), which encourages hθ​ to fit the data. E.g., when the loss function is the least square loss (aka mean squared error), we have J(θ)=n1​∑i=1n​(y(i)−hθ​(x(i)))2. This loss function for training purposes is oftentimes referred to as the training loss/error/cost.

However, minimizing the training loss is not our ultimate goal—it is merely our approach towards the goal of learning a predictive model. The most important evaluation metric of a model is the loss on unseen test examples, which is oftentimes referred to as the test error. Formally, we sample a test example (x, y) from the so-called test distribution D, and measure the model's error on it, by, e.g., the mean squared error, (hθ​(x)−y)2. The expected loss/error over the randomness of the test example is called the test loss/error,

L(θ)=E(x,y)∼D​[(y−hθ​(x))2](8.1)

Note that the measurement of the error involves computing the expectation, and in practice, it can be approximated by the average error on many sampled test examples, which are referred to as the test dataset.

第三部分「泛化与正则化」. 本章讨论泛化: 模型在没见过的测试样本上的表现. 训练时最小化的是训练损失 (如平均平方误差), 但这只是手段, 真正的目标是测试误差: 从测试分布 D 中随机抽一个样本, 模型误差的期望 (8.1). 期望无法直接计算, 实践中用大量测试样本 (测试集) 上的平均误差来近似.

为什么要另留测试集: 训练集已经被用来选参数, 训练误差对模型来说是「开卷考试», 天然偏乐观. 只有训练过程完全没碰过的数据才能无偏地估计 L(θ). 同理, 若反复看测试集结果来调模型, 测试集也会逐渐被「用掉», 所以第 9 章会再引入验证集 (交叉验证) 专门用于调参, 测试集只在最后用一次.

Page 104–105

Note that the key difference here between training and test datasets is that the test examples are unseen, in the sense that the training procedure has not used the test examples. In classical statistical learning settings, the training examples are also drawn from the same distribution as the test distribution D, but still the test examples are unseen by the learning procedure whereas the training examples are seen.

Because of this key difference between training and test datasets, even if they are both drawn from the same distribution D, the test error is not necessarily always close to the training error. As a result, successfully minimizing the training error may not always lead to a small test error. We typically say the model overfits the data if the model predicts accurately on the training dataset but doesn't generalize well to other test examples, that is, if the training error is small but the test error is large. We say the model underfits the data if the training error is relatively large (and in this case, typically the test error is also relatively large.)

训练集与测试集的关键区别是测试样本「没见过»: 训练过程没有用过它们. 经典设定中两者来自同一分布, 但即便如此, 测试误差也不一定接近训练误差, 因为模型可能专门迁就了训练集的特殊之处. 过拟合: 训练误差小、测试误差大. 欠拟合: 训练误差本身就比较大 (测试误差通常也大). 本章把测试误差分解成偏差和方差两项, 讨论模型复杂度的权衡; 然后讲双下降现象 (8.2) 和经典的样本复杂度理论 (8.3).

Page 104–105 (Footnotes)

(Footnote 1) In theoretical and statistical literature, we oftentimes call the uniform distribution over the training set {(x(i),y(i))}i=1n​, denoted by D, an empirical distribution, and call D the population distribution. Partly because of this, the training loss is also referred to as the empirical loss/risk/error, and the test loss is also referred to as the population loss/risk/error.

(Footnote 2) These days, researchers have increasingly been more interested in the setting with “domain shift”, that is, the training distribution and test distribution are different.

(Footnote 3) the difference between test error and training error is often referred to as the generalization gap. The term generalization error in some literature means the test error, and in some other literature means the generalization gap.

(Footnote 4) e.g., larger than the intrinsic noise level of the data in regression problems.

脚注里的术语: 训练集上的均匀分布叫经验分布 D, 真实分布 D 叫总体分布, 所以训练损失也叫经验风险, 测试损失也叫总体风险. 训练分布与测试分布不同的情形叫域偏移, 现在越来越受关注. 测试误差减训练误差叫泛化差距; 「泛化误差」一词有的文献指测试误差, 有的指泛化差距, 读文献时要分清 (8.3 节的 ε(h) 指的是前者). 「训练误差比较大」的标准, 回归中可以理解为明显高于数据本身的噪声水平.

经验风险可以写成对经验分布求期望: L^(θ)=E(x,y)∼D​[(y−hθ​(x))2], 与 (8.1) 只差分布不同. 训练就是在用 D 代替 D; 样本越多, 两者越接近, 8.3 节讨论的就是「接近到什么程度」.

偏差–方差权衡
8.1 Bias-variance tradeoff

Page 106

As an illustrating example, we consider the following training dataset and test dataset, which are also shown in Figure 8.1. The training inputs x(i)'s are randomly chosen and the outputs y(i) are generated by y(i)=h⋆(x(i))+ξ(i) where the function h⋆(⋅) is a quadratic function and is shown in Figure 8.1 as the solid line, and ξ(i) is the a observation noise assumed to be generated from ∼N(0,σ2). A test example (x, y) also has the same input-output relationship y=h⋆(x)+ξ where ξ∼N(0,σ2). It's impossible to predict the noise ξ, and therefore essentially our goal is to recover the function h⋆(⋅).

We will consider the test error of learning various types of models. When talking about linear regression, we discussed the problem of whether to fit a “simple” model such as the linear “y=θ0​+θ1​x,” or a more “complex” model such as the polynomial “y=θ0​+θ1​x+⋯θ5​x5.”

贯穿本节的例子: 真实函数 h⋆ 是二次函数, 观测值 = 真实值 + 正态噪声 ξ. 训练集和测试集都这样生成 (训练集只有几个点). 噪声无法预测, 所以目标本质上是还原 h⋆. 比较的是第 1 章提过的问题: 用简单的线性模型还是复杂的五次多项式.

这个设定很理想化: 真实函数已知、噪声是正态的、训练和测试同分布. 好处是可以把测试误差中「噪声造成的部分」和「模型造成的部分」分开来看; 真实问题里 h⋆ 未知, 只能通过训练误差、验证误差的对比间接判断.

讲义笔误: "is the a observation noise" 中 the 与 a 重复.

Page 106–107

We start with fitting a linear model, as shown in Figure 8.2. The best fitted linear model cannot predict y from x accurately even on the training dataset, let alone on the test dataset. This is because the true relationship between y and x is not linear—any linear model is far away from the true function h⋆(⋅). As a result, the training error is large and this is a typical situation of underfitting.

The issue cannot be mitigated with more training examples—even with a very large amount of, or even infinite training examples, the best fitted linear model is still inaccurate and fails to capture the structure of the data (Figure 8.3). Even if the noise is not present in the training data, the issue still occurs (Figure 8.4). Therefore, the fundamental bottleneck here is the linear model family's inability to capture the structure in the data—linear models cannot represent the true quadratic function h⋆—, but not the lack of the data. Informally, we define the bias of a model to be the test error even if we were to fit it to a very (say, infinitely) large training dataset. Thus, in this case, the linear model suffers from large bias, and underfits (i.e., fails to capture structure exhibited by) the data.

先拟合直线 (图 8.2): 连训练集都拟合不好, 典型的欠拟合. 原因是真实关系不是线性的. 加数据也没用 (图 8.3), 去掉噪声也没用 (图 8.4): 瓶颈是线性模型族表示不了二次函数, 而不是数据不够. 非正式地定义偏差: 用无穷多数据训练后仍然存在的测试误差. 线性模型在这里偏差很大.

易错: 偏差大不等于「模型不好用的数据少», 而是模型族本身离真实函数太远. 判断偏差主导的信号是: 训练误差和测试误差都高, 而且两者接近. 此时补救方法是让模型更灵活 (加特征、换非线性模型), 而不是收集更多数据.

Page 107–108

Next, we fit a 5th-degree polynomial to the data. Figure 8.5 shows that it fails to learn a good model either. However, the failure pattern is different from the linear model case. Specifically, even though the learnt 5th-degree polynomial did a very good job predicting y(i)'s from x(i)'s for training examples, it does not work well on test examples (Figure 8.5). In other words, the model learnt from the training set does not generalize well to other test examples—the test error is high. Contrary to the behavior of linear models, the bias of the 5-th degree polynomials is small—if we were to fit a 5-th degree polynomial to an extremely large dataset, the resulting model would be close to a quadratic function and be accurate (Figure 8.6). This is because the family of 5-th degree polynomials contains all the quadratic functions (setting θ5​=θ4​=θ3​=0 results in a quadratic function), and, therefore, 5-th degree polynomials are in principle capable of capturing the structure of the data.

再拟合五次多项式: 训练点几乎全部穿过 (训练误差为 0), 但测试误差很大, 典型的过拟合. 失败方式与直线不同: 五次多项式的偏差很小, 因为它包含所有二次函数 (高次系数取 0 即可), 在超大数据集上拟合会几乎还原真实函数 (图 8.6). 所以图 8.5 的问题不在模型族表示能力, 而在数据太少. 图注中 "recover the the ground truth" 的 the 重复.

Page 108–109

The failure of fitting 5-th degree polynomials can be captured by another component of the test error, called variance of a model fitting procedure. Specifically, when fitting a 5-th degree polynomial as in Figure 8.7, there is a large risk that we're fitting patterns in the data that happened to be present in our small, finite training set, but that do not reflect the wider pattern of the relationship between x and y. These “spurious” patterns in the training set are (mostly) due to the observation noise ξ(i), and fitting these spurious patters results in a model with large test error. In this case, we say the model has a large variance.

The variance can be intuitively (and mathematically, as shown in Section 8.1.1) characterized by the amount of variations across models learnt on multiple different training datasets (drawn from the same underlying distribution). The “spurious patterns” are specific to the randomness of the noise (and inputs) in a particular dataset, and thus are different across multiple training datasets. Therefore, overfitting to the “spurious patterns” of multiple datasets should result in very different models. Indeed, as shown in Figure 8.7, the models learned on the three different training datasets are quite different, overfitting to the “spurious patterns” of each datasets.

五次多项式的失败用测试误差的另一部分方差来刻画: 小训练集里碰巧出现的「虚假模式» (主要由噪声造成) 也被模型拟合进去了, 而这些模式不反映 x 与 y 的真实关系. 直观衡量: 从同一分布抽多个训练集分别训练, 学到的模型之间差别有多大. 每个数据集的噪声不同, 虚假模式也不同, 所以过拟合会得到差别很大的模型 (图 8.7). 方差大 = 模型对训练集的偶然性过于敏感.

方差的另一种理解: 方差衡量的是学习过程的「不稳定»: 训练集换几个点, 学到的函数就大变. 稳定的算法 (如强正则化的模型) 方差小. 实践中可以用 bootstrap 从同一个训练集中有放回地抽出多个训练集来近似「多个独立数据集», 观察模型预测的波动, 粗略估计方差.

讲义笔误: "spurious patters" 应为 patterns; "each datasets" 单复数不一致.

Page 109–110

Often, there is a tradeoff between bias and variance. If our model is too “simple” and has very few parameters, then it may have large bias (but small variance), and it typically may suffer from underfittng. If it is too “complex” and has very many parameters, then it may suffer from large variance (but have smaller bias), and thus overfitting. See Figure 8.8 for a typical tradeoff between bias and variance.

读图: 横轴是模型复杂度. 偏差² (蓝) 随复杂度单调下降, 方差 (红) 单调上升, 两者之和 (黑) 先降后升, 最低点就是最优的权衡. 左侧区域欠拟合 (偏差主导), 右侧区域过拟合 (方差主导).

Page 110

As we will see formally in Section 8.1.1, the test error can be decomposed as a summation of bias and variance. This means that the test error will have a convex curve as the model complexity increases, and in practice we should tune the model complexity to achieve the best tradeoff. For instance, in the example above, fitting a quadratic function does better than either of the extremes of a first or a 5-th degree polynomial, as shown in Figure 8.9.

Interestingly, the bias-variance tradeoff curves or the test error curves do not universally follow the shape in Figure 8.8, at least not universally when the model complexity is simply measured by the number of parameters. (We will discuss the so-called double descent phenomenon in Section 8.2.) Nevertheless, the principle of bias-variance tradeoff is perhaps still the first resort when analyzing and predicting the behavior of test errors.

偏差–方差权衡: 模型太简单 (参数少), 偏差大、方差小, 欠拟合; 太复杂 (参数多), 方差大、偏差小, 过拟合. 测试误差 = 偏差² + 方差 (+ 噪声), 前者随复杂度下降、后者上升, 于是测试误差呈 U 形, 应选中间的复杂度. 例子中二次模型最好. 不过以参数个数衡量复杂度时, 测试误差曲线并不总是 U 形 (见 8.2 的双下降); 尽管如此, 偏差–方差权衡仍是分析测试误差的首选工具.

讲义问题: ① "underfittng" 应为 underfitting. ② "the test error will have a convex curve" 说得过头: 两条单调曲线之和未必是凸函数, 准确的说法是通常呈先降后升的 U 形.

模拟验证 (自编, 用 Python 计算): 真实函数 h⋆(x)=2.5(x−0.4)2+0.2, 噪声 σ = 0.2, 训练集 n = 10 个点 (在 [0, 1] 上分层随机抽取), 重复 2000 次, 在 [0.1, 0.9] 上平均. 一次: 偏差² ≈ 0.0215, 方差 ≈ 0.0074; 二次: 偏差² ≈ 0, 方差 ≈ 0.0094; 五次: 偏差² ≈ 0, 方差 ≈ 0.0231. 加上噪声 σ2=0.04, 测试误差约为 0.069、0.049、0.063, 二次最好. n 增大到 100 时, 三者的方差都缩小约 10 倍 (0.0007、0.0009、0.0018), 而一次模型的偏差² 仍是 0.021, 不随数据量变化, 与正文的论述一致.

偏差–方差的数学分解
8.1.1 A mathematical decomposition (for regression)

Page 111

To formally state the bias-variance tradeoff for regression problems, we consider the following setup (which is an extension of the beginning paragraph of Section 8.1).

  • Draw a training dataset S={x(i),y(i)}i=1n​ such that y(i)=h⋆(x(i))+ξ(i) where ξ(i)∈N(0,σ2).
  • Train a model on the dataset S, denoted by h^S​.
  • Take a test example (x, y) such that y=h⋆(x)+ξ where ξ∼N(0,σ2), and measure the expected test error (averaged over the random draw of the training set S and the randomness of ξ) MSE(x)=ES,ξ​[(y−hS​(x))2](8.2)

(Footnote 5) For simplicity, the test input x is considered to be fixed here, but the same conceptual message holds when we average over the choice of x's. (Footnote 6) The subscript under the expectation symbol is to emphasize the variables that are considered as random by the expectation operation.

形式化的设定: ① 按「真实函数 + 噪声」抽一个训练集 S; ② 在 S 上训练得到 h^S​; ③ 在固定的测试输入 x 处, 对训练集的随机性和测试噪声同时取期望, 得到 MSE(x). 注意期望里有两种随机性: 训练集 S (影响学到的模型) 和测试噪声 ξ. 固定 x 只是为了简化, 对 x 再取平均结论不变.

讲义问题: ① 第一条写成 ξ(i)∈N(0,σ2), 应为 ∼ (服从分布, 不是属于集合). ② 前面记作 h^S​, 公式里又写 hS​, 记号不统一, 指的是同一个模型.

Page 111

We will decompose the MSE into a bias and variance term. We start by stating a following simple mathematical tool that will be used twice below.

Claim 8.1.1: Suppose A and B are two independent real random variables and E[A] = 0. Then, E[(A+B)2]=E[A2]+E[B2].

As a corollary, because a random variable A is independent with a constant c, when E[A] = 0, we have E[(A+c)2]=E[A2]+c2.

The proof of the claim follows from expanding the square: E[(A+B)2]=E[A2]+E[B2]+2E[AB]=E[A2]+E[B2]. Here we used the independence to show that E[AB]=E[A]E[B]=0.

Using Claim 8.1.1 with A = ξ and B=h⋆(x)−h^S​(x), we have

​MSE(x)=E[(y−hS​(x))2]=E[(ξ+(h⋆(x)−hS​(x)))2](8.3)=E[ξ2]+E[(h⋆(x)−hS​(x))2]=σ2+E[(h⋆(x)−hS​(x))2](8.4)​

工具 (断言 8.1.1): A、B 独立且 A 均值为 0 时, (A+B)2 的期望等于两者平方期望之和, 交叉项 2E[AB] = 2E[A]E[B] = 0. 推论: 常数 c 与任何随机变量独立, 所以 E[(A+c)2]=E[A2]+c2. 第一次使用: A = 测试噪声 ξ, B = 真实值与模型预测之差. 测试噪声与训练集无关, 所以独立, MSE 拆成噪声方差 σ2 加上「模型与真实函数之差」的平方期望 (8.4).

两次用断言时独立性从哪来: 第一次, 测试噪声 ξ 与训练集 S 独立 (测试样本是另外抽的), 所以 ξ 与 h⋆(x)−hS​(x) 独立, 且 E[ξ] = 0. 第二次, c 是常数, 自然与随机变量独立; 而 A=havg​(x)−hS​(x) 对 S 取期望正好是 0, 这是 havg​ 定义的直接结果. 所以这个分解对任何学习算法都成立, 不需要假设模型是线性的.

Page 111–112

Then, let's define havg​(x)=ES​[hS​(x)] as the “average model”—the model obtained by drawing an infinite number of datasets, training on them, and averaging their predictions on x. Note that havg​ is a hypothetical model for analytical purposes that can not be obtained in reality (because we don't have infinite number of datasets). It turns out that for many cases, havg​ is (approximately) equal to the the model obtained by training on a single dataset with infinite samples. Thus, we can also intuitively interpret havg​ this way, which is consistent with our intuitive definition of bias in the previous subsection.

We can further decompose MSE(x) by letting c=h⋆(x)−havg​(x) (which is a constant that does not depend on the choice of S!) and A=havg​(x)−hS​(x) in the corollary part of Claim 8.1.1:

MSE(x)​=σ2+E[(h⋆(x)−hS​(x))2](8.5)=σ2+(h⋆(x)−havg​(x))2+E[(havg​−hS​(x))2](8.6)=unavoidableσ2​​+≜ bias2(h⋆(x)−havg​(x))2​​+≜ variancevar(hS​(x))​​(8.7)​

定义平均模型 havg​(x)=ES​[hS​(x)]: 在无穷多个训练集上分别训练再把预测取平均. 它只是分析用的假想模型; 很多情况下约等于在一个无穷大的数据集上训练得到的模型, 与上一节偏差的直观定义一致. 第二次使用断言: 常数 c = 真实值 − 平均预测, A = 平均预测 − 本次预测 (对 S 的均值为 0). 于是得到三项分解 (8.7): 不可避免的噪声 σ2 + 偏差² (平均模型离真实函数多远) + 方差 (单次训练的预测围绕平均模型的波动).

讲义笔误: (8.6) 中 E[(havg​−hS​(x))2] 的 havg​ 漏了 (x); "equal to the the model" 中 the 重复.

Page 112

We call the second term the bias (square) and the third term the variance. As discussed before, the bias captures the part of the error that are introduced due to the lack of expressivity of the model. Recall that havg​ can be thought of as the best possible model learned even with infinite data. Thus, the bias is not due to the lack of data, but is rather caused by that the family of models fundamentally cannot approximate the h⋆. For example, in the illustrating example in Figure 8.2, because any linear model cannot approximate the true quadratic function h⋆, neither can havg​, and thus the bias term has to be large.

The variance term captures how the random nature of the finite dataset introduces errors in the learned model. It measures the sensitivity of the learned model to the randomness in the dataset. It often decreases as the size of the dataset increases.

There is nothing we can do about the first term σ2 as we can not predict the noise ξ by definition.

Finally, we note that the bias-variance decomposition for classification is much less clear than for regression problems. There have been several proposals, but there is as yet no agreement on what is the “right” and/or the most useful formalism.

三项的含义: 偏差来自模型表达能力不足 (数据再多也消不掉); 方差来自有限数据集的随机性, 衡量模型对数据随机性的敏感程度, 通常随数据量增加而下降; 噪声项无论如何都无法减小. 分类问题 (0-1 损失) 的偏差–方差分解没有公认的形式, 因为平方展开的技巧不适用.

注意偏差和方差都是针对「学习过程」(模型族 + 训练算法 + 数据量) 定义的, 而不是针对某一个学到的模型. 同一个模型族, 加正则化会增大偏差、减小方差; 增加数据会减小方差而不影响偏差 (在 havg​ 近似于无穷数据模型的意义下).

怎样用这个分解指导实践: 训练误差高 (接近测试误差) → 偏差主导: 换更复杂的模型、加特征、减弱正则化, 加数据帮助不大. 训练误差低、测试误差高 → 方差主导: 加数据、简化模型、加强正则化 (第 9 章)、做集成 (如 bagging 对多个模型取平均, 正是在逼近 havg​, 直接削减方差). 补充讲义合集里的 ML-advice 讲义系统地讲了这种诊断方法.

双下降现象
8.2 The double descent phenomenon

Page 112–113

Model-wise double descent. Recent works have demonstrated that the test error can present a “double descent” phenomenon in a range of machine learning models including linear models and deep neural networks. The conventional wisdom, as discussed in Section 8.1, is that as we increase the model complexity, the test error first decreases and then increases, as illustrated in Figure 8.8. However, in many cases, we empirically observe that the test error can have a second descent—it first decreases, then increases to a peak around when the model size is large enough to fit all the training data very well, and then decreases again in the so-called overparameterized regime, where the number of parameters is larger than the number of data points. See Figure 8.10 for an illustration of the typical curves of test errors against model complexity (measured by the number of parameters). To some extent, the overparameterized regime with the second descent is considered as new to the machine learning community—partly because lightly-regularized, overparameterized models are only extensively used in the deep learning era.

(Footnote 7) The discovery of the phenomenon perhaps dates back to Opper [1995, 2001], and has been recently popularized by Belkin et al. [2020], Hastie et al. [2019], etc.

模型维度的双下降: 传统认识是随复杂度增加测试误差先降后升. 但在线性模型、深度网络等很多模型中观察到第二次下降: 先降, 再升, 在模型恰好大到能完美拟合训练数据时达到峰值, 之后在过参数化区域 (参数多于样本) 再次下降. 这个区域在深度学习时代才被大量使用 (轻度正则化的超大模型), 所以显得新. 最早可追溯到 Opper 在 1990 年代的工作, 近年由 Belkin 等人推广.

峰值处发生了什么: 参数个数刚好等于样本数时, 模型恰好有「唯一」一种方式穿过所有训练点, 没有任何余地去选一个平滑的解, 只能扭曲自己去拟合噪声, 所以方差暴涨. 参数再多一些, 能完美拟合数据的解有无穷多个, 优化器 (配合隐式正则化) 就能在其中挑一个「最温和」的, 测试误差反而下降.

Page 113

A practical implication of the phenomenon is that one should not hold back from scaling into and experimenting with over-parametrized models because the test error may well decrease again to a level even smaller than the previous lowest point. Actually, in many cases, larger overparameterized models always lead to a better test performance (meaning there won't be a second ascent after the second descent).

Figure 8.10: A typical model-wise double descent phenomenon. As the number of parameters increases, the test error first decreases when the number of parameters is smaller than the training data. Then in the overparameterized regime, the test error decreases again.

实践意义: 不要因为害怕过拟合就不敢尝试过参数化的大模型, 测试误差可能再次下降, 甚至低于经典区域的最低点; 很多情况下模型越大越好, 第二次下降之后不再上升. 这正是当今大模型 (第 14 章) 越做越大的经验依据之一. 读图: 峰值出现在「参数个数刚好够拟合训练数据」的位置 (线性模型中即参数数 ≈ 样本数).

Page 114

Sample-wise double descent. A priori, we would expect that more training examples always lead to smaller test errors—more samples give strictly more information for the algorithm to learn from. However, recent work [Nakkiran, 2019] observes that the test error is not monotonically decreasing as we increase the sample size. Instead, as shown in Figure 8.11, the test error decreases, and then increases and peaks around when the number of examples (denoted by n) is similar to the number of parameters (denoted by d), and then decreases again. We refer to this as the sample-wise double descent phenomenon. To some extent, sample-wise double descent and model-wise double descent are essentially describing similar phenomena—the test error is peaked when n ≈ d.

样本维度的双下降: 按理说样本越多测试误差越小 (更多样本提供的信息严格更多), 但 Nakkiran (2019) 的实验发现: 样本数 n 增加时测试误差先降、再升, 在 n ≈ d (参数数) 处达到峰值, 然后再降. 两种双下降说的是同一件事: n ≈ d 时测试误差有峰. 在线性模型里, 固定 d 增加 n (样本维度) 和固定 n 增加 d (模型维度) 都会经过 n = d 这个临界点.

Page 114

Explanation and mitigation strategy. The sample-wise double descent, or, in particular, the peak of test error at n ≈ d, suggests that the existing training algorithms evaluated in these experiments are far from optimal when n ≈ d. We will be better off by tossing away some examples and run the algorithms with a smaller sample size to steer clear of the peak. In other words, in principle, there are other algorithms that can achieve smaller test error when n ≈ d, but the algorithms evaluated in these experiments fail to do so. The sub-optimality of the learning procedure appears to be the culprit of the peak in both sample-wise and model-wise double descent.

Indeed, with an optimally-tuned regularization (which will be discussed more in Section 9), the test error in the n ≈ d regime can be dramatically improved, and the model-wise and sample-wise double descent are both mitigated. See Figure 8.11.

解释: 峰值说明实验中用的算法在 n ≈ d 时远非最优: 在这附近丢掉一些样本反而更好, 这对一个好算法来说不应该发生. 所以峰值的罪魁是学习过程本身不够好. 缓解: 调好正则化强度 (第 9 章), n ≈ d 处的测试误差可以大幅下降, 两种双下降都会消失.

Page 114–115

The intuition above only explains the peak in the model-wise and sample-wise double descent, but does not explain the second descent in the model-wise double descent—why overparameterized models are able to generalize so well. The theoretical understanding of overparameterized models is an active research area with many recent advances. A typical explanation is that the commonly-used optimizers such as gradient descent provide an implicit regularization effect (which will be discussed in more detail in Section 9.2). In other words, even in the overparameterized regime and with an unregularized loss function, the model is still implicitly regularized, and thus exhibits a better test performance than an arbitrary solution that fits the data. For example, for linear models, when n ≪ d, the gradient descent optimizer with zero initialization finds the minimum norm solution that fits the data (instead of an arbitrary solution that fits the data), and the minimum norm regularizer turns out to be a sufficiently good for the overparameterized regime (but it's not a good regularizer when n ≈ d, resulting in the peak of test error).

上面只解释了峰值, 没有解释第二次下降: 为什么过参数化的模型泛化得好? 这是活跃的研究领域. 一种典型解释是隐式正则化: 梯度下降之类的优化器本身偏好某些特定的解. 即使损失函数里没有正则项, 在无穷多个能完美拟合训练数据的解中, 优化器找到的也不是随便一个, 而是「好」的一个. 例: 线性模型在 n ≪ d 时, 从 0 出发的梯度下降收敛到最小范数的插值解; 最小范数在过参数化区域是不错的正则化, 但在 n ≈ d 时不够好, 于是出现峰值.

与大模型的联系: 现代语言模型参数动辄数十亿以上, 常常远多于有效样本, 按经典理论应严重过拟合, 实际上却泛化很好. 隐式正则化、训练早停、数据增强、架构本身的归纳偏置都被认为起了作用. 第 14 章的自监督预训练还表明: 在海量无标注数据上学到的表示, 让下游任务所需的标注样本大大减少.

讲义笔误: "turns out to be a sufficiently good for" 中 a 多余 (或漏了名词 regularizer). (PDF 中 "when n ≪ d" 的 ≪ 符号在文本层丢失, 以页面图像为准.)

为什么从 0 出发的梯度下降得到最小范数解: 线性回归的梯度 X⊤(Xθ−y​) 总在 X 的行空间里; 从 θ = 0 出发, θ 永远停留在行空间 (与第 5 章「θ 是样本特征的线性组合」是同一个论证). 在所有满足 Xθ=y​ 的解中, 行空间里的那个唯一, 而且正是范数最小的那个 (其他解 = 它 + 零空间中的分量, 范数只会更大). 所以没有显式正则项, 优化过程本身就选出了最小范数解.

Using the optimal regularization parameter λ (optimally tuned for each n, shown in green solid curve) mitigates double descent. 这幅图的启示: 双下降的峰并不是过参数化模型的本质缺陷, 而是「没有正则化」造成的. 调好正则化后, 更多数据总是更好, 这才符合直觉.

为什么 n ≈ d 时最糟: 不加正则化时, n 略大于 d 的最小二乘解要求 (X⊤X)−1, 而 n ≈ d 时 X⊤X 的最小特征值接近 0 (矩阵接近奇异), 求逆把噪声放大很多倍, 解的范数暴涨 (图 8.12 中间的尖峰). n 远大于 d 时矩阵良态; n 远小于 d 时取最小范数解, 也不会暴涨. 岭回归在 X⊤X 上加 λI, 正好把最小特征值从 0 附近抬起来.

Page 115–116

Finally, we also remark that the double descent phenomenon has been mostly observed when the model complexity is measured by the number of parameters. It is unclear if and when the number of parameters is the best complexity measure of a model. For example, in many situations, the norm of the models is used as a complexity measure. As shown in Figure 8.12 right, for a particular linear case, if we plot the test error against the norm of the learnt model, the double descent phenomenon no longer occurs. This is partly because the norm of the learned model is also peaked around n ≈ d (See Figure 8.12 (middle) or Belkin et al. [2019], …). For deep neural networks, the correct complexity measure is even more elusive. The study of double descent phenomenon is an active research topic.

双下降主要在「以参数个数衡量复杂度」时出现, 而参数个数未必是最好的复杂度度量. 换成学到的模型的范数作为复杂度: 范数本身在 n ≈ d 时有尖峰 (中图), 以范数为横轴画测试误差, 曲线更接近传统的偏差–方差形状 (右图), 双下降消失. 对深度网络, 什么是正确的复杂度度量更不清楚, 双下降仍是活跃的研究课题.

样本复杂度界
8.3 Sample complexity bounds (optional readings) · 8.3.1 Preliminaries

Page 117

In this set of notes, we begin our foray into learning theory. Apart from being interesting and enlightening in its own right, this discussion will also help us hone our intuitions and derive rules of thumb about how to best apply learning algorithms in different settings. We will also seek to answer a few questions: … can we make formal the bias/variance tradeoff …? … Why should doing well on the training set tell us anything about generalization error? … are there conditions under which we can actually prove that learning algorithms will work well?

We start with two simple but very useful lemmas.

Lemma. (The union bound). Let A1​,A2​,…,Ak​ be k different events (that may not be independent). Then

P(A1​∪⋯∪Ak​)≤P(A1​)+…+P(Ak​).

In probability theory, the union bound is usually stated as an axiom (and thus we won't try to prove it), but it also makes intuitive sense: The probability of any one of k events happening is at most the sum of the probabilities of the k different events.

开始学习理论. 要回答三个问题: ① 能否把偏差–方差权衡形式化 (由此引出模型选择)? ② 我们关心的是泛化误差, 算法却在训练集上拟合, 为什么训练集上表现好能说明泛化好? ③ 在什么条件下能证明学习算法一定有效? 第一个工具是联合界: 若干事件至少一个发生的概率, 不超过各自概率之和 (不要求独立). 重叠部分被重复计算了, 所以是不等式.

本节的整体结构: ① 工具: 联合界 + Hoeffding; ② 有限假设类: 单个假设的训练误差集中在泛化误差附近 → 联合界推出对所有假设一致收敛 → ERM 的结果接近最优; ③ 无限假设类: 用 VC 维代替 log k, 结论形式相同. 每一步都是在回答: 「为什么在训练集上表现好, 就能推出在新数据上表现好?»

讲义问题: 说联合界「通常作为公理」不准确: 概率论的公理是互斥事件的可加性, 联合界是由它推出的定理 (把并集拆成互斥的 A1​、A2​∖A1​、… 即可, 每块的概率不超过对应的 P(Ai​)). 标题 "optional readings" 也与前面各章的 "optional reading" 不一致.

Page 117–118

Lemma. (Hoeffding inequality) Let Z1​,…,Zn​ be n independent and identically distributed (iid) random variables drawn from a Bernoulli(φ) distribution. I.e., P(Zi​=1)=ϕ, and P(Zi​=0)=1−ϕ. Let ϕ^​=(1/n)∑i=1n​Zi​ be the mean of these random variables, and let any γ > 0 be fixed. Then

P(∣ϕ−ϕ^​∣>γ)≤2exp(−2γ2n)

This lemma (which in learning theory is also called the Chernoff bound) says that if we take ϕ^​—the average of n Bernoulli(φ) random variables—to be our estimate of φ, then the probability of our being far from the true value is small, so long as n is large. Another way of saying this is that if you have a biased coin whose chance of landing on heads is φ, then if you toss it n times and calculate the fraction of times that it came up heads, that will be a good estimate of φ with high probability (if n is large).

Using just these two lemmas, we will be able to prove some of the deepest and most important results in learning theory.

第二个工具是 Hoeffding 不等式 (学习理论中也叫 Chernoff 界): n 次独立伯努利试验的频率 ϕ^​ 偏离真实概率 φ 超过 γ 的概率, 不超过 2e−2γ2n. 随 n 指数下降: 抛一枚不均匀的硬币足够多次, 正面的频率以很高的概率接近真实概率. 与切比雪夫不等式 (只给出 1/n 的衰减) 相比, 这个界强得多, 而且不依赖 φ.

算一下 (用 Python): γ = 0.05、n = 1000 时, 右边 = 2e−5≈0.0135, 即抛 1000 次, 频率偏离真实概率超过 5 个百分点的概率不到 1.4%. 补充讲义合集里的 hoeffding 讲义给出了这个不等式的证明 (更一般地, 对任意有界独立随机变量成立).

Page 118

To simplify our exposition, let's restrict our attention to binary classification in which the labels are y ∈ {0, 1}. Everything we'll say here generalizes to other problems, including regression and multi-class classification.

We assume we are given a training set S={(x(i),y(i));i=1,…,n} of size n, where the training examples (x(i),y(i)) are drawn iid from some probability distribution D. For a hypothesis h, we define the training error (also called the empirical risk or empirical error in learning theory) to be

ε^(h)=n1​i=1∑n​1{h(x(i))=y(i)}.

This is just the fraction of training examples that h misclassifies. When we want to make explicit the dependence of ε^(h) on the training set S, we may also write this a ε^S​(h). We also define the generalization error to be

ε(h)=P(x,y)∼D​(h(x)=y).

I.e. this is the probability that, if we now draw a new example (x, y) from the distribution D, h will misclassify it.

Note that we have assumed that the training data was drawn from the same distribution D with which we're going to evaluate our hypotheses (in the definition of generalization error). This is sometimes also referred to as one of the PAC assumptions.

(Footnote 9) PAC stands for “probably approximately correct,” which is a framework and set of assumptions under which numerous results on learning theory were proved. Of these, the assumption of training and testing on the same distribution, and the assumption of the independently drawn training examples, were the most important.

为简单起见只讨论二分类 (结论可推广). 训练样本独立同分布地取自 D. 训练误差 (经验风险) ε^(h) 是 h 在训练集上分错的比例; 泛化误差 ε(h) 是 h 在新样本上分错的概率. 训练和测试来自同一分布, 是 PAC (概率近似正确) 框架的假设之一; 另一个最重要的假设是训练样本相互独立. 「概率近似正确」的意思是: 以高概率 (1 − δ) 保证误差接近最优 (相差 γ 以内).

讲义笔误: "we may also write this a ε^S​(h)" 中 a 应为 as.

Page 118–119

Consider the setting of linear classification, and let hθ​(x)=1{θTx≥0}. What's a reasonable way of fitting the parameters θ? One approach is to try to minimize the training error, and pick

θ^=argθmin​ε^(hθ​).

We call this process empirical risk minimization (ERM), and the resulting hypothesis output by the learning algorithm is h^=hθ^​. We think of ERM as the most “basic” learning algorithm, and it will be this algorithm that we focus on in these notes. (Algorithms such as logistic regression can also be viewed as approximations to empirical risk minimization.)

In our study of learning theory, it will be useful to abstract away from the specific parameterization of hypotheses and from issues such as whether we're using a linear classifier. We define the hypothesis class H used by a learning algorithm to be the set of all classifiers considered by it. For linear classification, H={hθ​:hθ​(x)=1{θTx≥0},θ∈Rd+1} is thus the set of all classifiers over X (the domain of the inputs) where the decision boundary is linear. More broadly, if we were studying, say, neural networks, then we could let H be the set of all classifiers representable by some neural network architecture.

Empirical risk minimization can now be thought of as a minimization over the class of functions H, in which the learning algorithm picks the hypothesis:

h^=argh∈Hmin​ε^(h)

经验风险最小化 (ERM): 选训练误差最小的参数. 它是最「基本」的学习算法, 本节的理论都针对它. 逻辑回归等可以看作 ERM 的近似 (0-1 损失不连续, 难以直接优化, 就换成光滑的替代损失). 把参数化抽象掉, 定义假设类 H: 算法考虑的所有分类器的集合 (如所有线性分类器、某种结构的所有神经网络). ERM 就是在 H 中选训练误差最小的 h^.

把参数化抽象成假设类的好处: 后面的理论只关心「有多少种可选的分类器」(有限时是个数 k, 无限时是 VC 维), 而不关心它们是怎么写出来的, 这样结论对线性分类器、决策树、神经网络都适用.

有限假设类
8.3.2 The case of finite H

Page 119

Let's start by considering a learning problem in which we have a finite hypothesis class H={h1​,…,hk​} consisting of k hypotheses. Thus, H is just a set of k functions mapping from X to {0, 1}, and empirical risk minimization selects h^ to be whichever of these k functions has the smallest training error.

We would like to give guarantees on the generalization error of h^. Our strategy for doing so will be in two parts: First, we will show that ε^(h) is a reliable estimate of ε(h) for all h. Second, we will show that this implies an upper-bound on the generalization error of h^.

Take any one, fixed, hi​∈H. Consider a Bernoulli random variable Z whose distribution is defined as follows. We're going to sample (x,y)∼D. Then, we set Z=1{hi​(x)=y}. I.e., we're going to draw one example, and let Z indicate whether hi​ misclassifies it. Similarly, we also define Zj​=1{hi​(x(j))=y(j)}. Since our training set was drawn iid from D, Z and the Zj​'s have the same distribution.

We see that the misclassification probability on a randomly drawn example—that is, ε(h)—is exactly the expected value of Z (and Zj​). Moreover, the training error can be written

ε^(hi​)=n1​j=1∑n​Zj​.

先看有限假设类 (k 个假设). 证明分两步: ① 对所有 h, 训练误差都是泛化误差的可靠估计; ② 由此推出 ERM 选出的 h^ 泛化误差的上界. 第一步: 固定一个 hi​, 令 Zj​ 表示它是否分错第 j 个训练样本. Zj​ 是独立同分布的伯努利变量, 均值正是泛化误差 ε(hi​), 训练误差就是它们的平均, 正好可以用 Hoeffding 不等式. 关键: hi​ 必须在看到训练集之前就固定, 这一点在下面很重要.

有限假设类并非只是玩具: 例如「在 1000 个候选特征里挑一个做阈值分类」、「从 50 个预先训练好的模型里挑一个」都是有限假设类. 在验证集上从 k 个候选模型中选最好的一个, 也正好是这个设定, 所以本节的界同样说明了: 用验证集挑模型时, 候选越多, 被验证集「偶然看好」的风险越大, 但只以 log k 增长.

Page 119–120

Thus, ε^(hi​) is exactly the mean of the n random variables Zj​ that are drawn iid from a Bernoulli distribution with mean ε(hi​). Hence, we can apply the Hoeffding inequality, and obtain

P(∣ε(hi​)−ε^(hi​)∣>γ)≤2exp(−2γ2n).

This shows that, for our particular hi​, training error will be close to generalization error with high probability, assuming n is large. But we don't just want to guarantee that ε(hi​) will be close to ε^(hi​) (with high probability) for just only one particular hi​. We want to prove that this will be true simultaneously for all h∈H. To do so, let Ai​ denote the event that ∣ε(hi​)−ε^(hi​)∣>γ. We've already shown that, for any particular Ai​, it holds true that P(Ai​)≤2exp(−2γ2n). Thus, using the union bound, we have that

​P(∃h∈H.∣ε(hi​)−ε^(hi​)∣>γ)=P(A1​∪⋯∪Ak​)≤i=1∑k​P(Ai​)≤i=1∑k​2exp(−2γ2n)=2kexp(−2γ2n)​

对单个 hi​, Hoeffding 给出训练误差与泛化误差相差超过 γ 的概率很小. 但 ERM 是看过训练集后才挑出 h^ 的, h^ 不是事先固定的, 不能直接套用; 所以需要对所有 h 同时成立的保证. 用联合界: 「某个 h 偏差超过 γ」的概率 ≤ k 个事件的概率之和 = 2ke−2γ2n.

讲义笔误: 公式里写 ∃h∈H.∣ε(hi​)−ε^(hi​)∣, 量词约束的是 h, 绝对值里却是 hi​, 应统一为 ∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣ (下面 ¬∃、∀ 两处同样); "for just only one" 中 just 与 only 重复.

Page 120

If we subtract both sides from 1, we find that

​P(¬∃h∈H.∣ε(hi​)−ε^(hi​)∣>γ)=P(∀h∈H.∣ε(hi​)−ε^(hi​)∣≤γ)≥1−2kexp(−2γ2n)​

(The “¬” symbol means “not.”) So, with probability at least 1−2kexp(−2γ2n), we have that ε(h) will be within γ of ε^(h) for all h∈H. This is called a uniform convergence result, because this is a bound that holds simultaneously for all (as opposed to just one) h∈H.

In the discussion above, what we did was, for particular values of n and γ, give a bound on the probability that for some h∈H, ∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣>γ. There are three quantities of interest here: n, γ, and the probability of error; we can bound either one in terms of the other two.

取补事件: 以至少 1−2ke−2γ2n 的概率, 所有 h 的训练误差都在泛化误差的 γ 范围内. 这叫一致收敛: 对整个假设类同时成立, 而不只对某一个 h. 这里涉及三个量: 样本数 n、误差容限 γ、失败概率; 固定任意两个就能界定第三个, 下面分别做.

这里的「收敛」是指 n → ∞ 时 maxh​∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣→0, 即训练误差作为泛化误差的估计, 在整个假设类上一致地变准.

一致收敛为什么必不可少: 设想 k 个完全随机猜测的分类器 (泛化误差都是 0.5). k 很大时, 纯属偶然, 总会有某个分类器在训练集上表现很好 (训练误差远低于 0.5). ERM 恰恰会挑中它, 但它的泛化误差仍是 0.5. 只对单个假设成立的 Hoeffding 界防不住这种「挑选效应», 必须对整个假设类同时控制偏差, 代价就是界里多出的 log k.

Page 120–121

For instance, we can ask the following question: Given γ and some δ > 0, how large must n be before we can guarantee that with probability at least 1 − δ, training error will be within γ of generalization error? By setting δ=2kexp(−2γ2n) and solving for n, [you should convince yourself this is the right thing to do!], we find that if

n≥2γ21​logδ2k​,

then with probability at least 1 − δ, we have that ∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣≤γ for all h∈H. (Equivalently, this shows that the probability that ∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣>γ for some h∈H is at most δ.) This bound tells us how many training examples we need in order make a guarantee. The training set size n that a certain method or algorithm requires in order to achieve a certain level of performance is also called the algorithm's sample complexity.

The key property of the bound above is that the number of training examples needed to make this guarantee is only logarithmic in k, the number of hypotheses in H. This will be important later.

Similarly, we can also hold n and δ fixed and solve for γ in the previous equation, and show [again, convince yourself that this is right!] that with probability 1 − δ, we have that for all h∈H,

∣ε^(h)−ε(h)∣≤2n1​logδ2k​​.

令失败概率 2ke−2γ2n=δ 解出 n: 只要 n≥2γ21​logδ2k​, 就以 1 − δ 的概率对所有 h 一致收敛. 达到某种性能所需的训练集大小叫样本复杂度. 关键: 它只与假设个数 k 的对数成正比, 假设类扩大一千倍, 所需样本只增加 log 1000 ≈ 7 个单位. 反过来固定 n 和 δ, 解出误差容限 γ = 2n1​logδ2k​​, 随 1/n​ 缩小.

推导: 由 2ke−2γ2n≤δ 两边取对数, log(2k)−2γ2n≤logδ, 移项得 n≥2γ21​logδ2k​; 若反过来固定 n 解 γ, 得 γ≥2n1​logδ2k​​, 取等号即可. 讲义的两处「你应该说服自己」就是这两步代数.

讲义笔误: "in order make a guarantee" 漏了 to.

代入数字 (用 Python 计算): k = 10000 个假设, γ = 0.05, δ = 0.01, 需要 n≥2×0.00251​log(2×106)≈2902 个样本. 反过来 n = 10000 时 γ ≈ 0.027. 一万个假设只需要几千个样本就能保证所有假设的训练误差都可信, 这就是「对数依赖」的威力.

Page 121

Now, let's assume that uniform convergence holds, i.e., that ∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣≤γ for all h∈H. What can we prove about the generalization of our learning algorithm that picked h^=argminh∈H​ε^(h)?

Define h∗=argminh∈H​ε(h) to be the best possible hypothesis in H. Note that h∗ is the best that we could possibly do given that we are using H, so it makes sense to compare our performance to that of h∗. We have:

ε(h^)​≤ε^(h^)+γ≤ε^(h∗)+γ≤ε(h∗)+2γ​

The first line used the fact that ∣ε(h^)−ε^(h^)∣≤γ (by our uniform convergence assumption). The second used the fact that h^ was chosen to minimize ε^(h), and hence ε^(h^)≤ε^(h) for all h, and in particular ε^(h^)≤ε^(h∗). The third line used the uniform convergence assumption again, to show that ε^(h∗)≤ε(h∗)+γ. So, what we've shown is the following: If uniform convergence occurs, then the generalization error of h^ is at most 2γ worse than the best possible hypothesis in H!

第二步: 设一致收敛成立. 记 h∗ 为 H 中泛化误差最小的假设 (用这个假设类能做到的最好). 三步不等式: ① h^ 的泛化误差 ≤ 它的训练误差 + γ (一致收敛); ② h^ 的训练误差 ≤ h∗ 的训练误差 (ERM 的定义); ③ h∗ 的训练误差 ≤ 它的泛化误差 + γ (再用一致收敛). 结论: ERM 选出的假设最多比最优假设差 2γ. 第 ① 步正是需要「一致」的地方: h^ 依赖训练集, 只有对所有 h 都成立的界才能用在它身上.

两个误差都只是「上界」: 2γ 是最坏情况; 实际中 h^ 的泛化误差常常比界好得多. 学习理论的界主要用来理解各个量之间的定性关系 (如样本数与假设类大小的对数关系), 很少直接用来算需要多少数据.

Page 121–122

Let's put all this together into a theorem.

Theorem. Let ∣H∣=k, and let any n, δ be fixed. Then with probability at least 1 − δ, we have that

ε(h^)≤(h∈Hmin​ε(h))+22n1​logδ2k​​.

This is proved by letting γ equal the ⋅​ term, using our previous argument that uniform convergence occurs with probability at least 1 − δ, and then noting that uniform convergence implies ε(h) is at most 2γ higher than ε(h∗)=minh∈H​ε(h) (as we showed previously).

This also quantifies what we were saying previously saying about the bias/variance tradeoff in model selection. Specifically, suppose we have some hypothesis class H, and are considering switching to some much larger hypothesis class H′⊇H. If we switch to H′, then the first term minh​ε(h) can only decrease (since we'd then be taking a min over a larger set of functions). Hence, by learning using a larger hypothesis class, our “bias” can only decrease. However, if k increases, then the second 2⋅​ term would also increase. This increase corresponds to our “variance” increasing when we use a larger hypothesis class.

合成定理: 以至少 1 − δ 的概率, ERM 的泛化误差 ≤ 假设类中最优的泛化误差 + 22n1​logδ2k​​. 这把偏差–方差权衡定量化了: 换成更大的假设类 H′⊇H, 第一项 (最优误差, 相当于「偏差») 只会减小; 但 k 变大, 第二项 (相当于「方差») 会增大. 证明里 "ε(h) is at most 2γ higher" 指的是 ε(h^).

界里两项的意义: 第一项 minh​ε(h) 只由假设类和数据分布决定, 与训练集大小无关, 对应偏差; 第二项随 n 增大以 1/n​ 的速度减小, 随假设类变大以 logk​ 增大, 对应方差. 所以「选多大的假设类」就是在这两项之间权衡, 第 9 章的模型选择要解决的正是这个问题.

讲义笔误: "what we were saying previously saying" 中 saying 重复; 证明一句里的 ε(h) 应为 ε(h^).

Page 122

By holding γ and δ fixed and solving for n like we did before, we can also obtain the following sample complexity bound:

Corollary. Let ∣H∣=k, and let any δ, γ be fixed. Then for ε(h^)≤minh∈H​ε(h)+2γ to hold with probability at least 1 − δ, it suffices that

n≥2γ21​logδ2k​=O(γ21​logδk​),

推论 (样本复杂度): 要以 1 − δ 的概率保证 ERM 的结果与最优相差 2γ 以内, n 只需 O(γ21​logδk​). 三个量的依赖关系: 精度要求提高一倍 (γ 减半), 样本数要变成 4 倍; 置信度要求提高 (δ 减小) 和假设类变大 (k 增大) 都只以对数代价增加样本数.

与偏差–方差的联系: 推论只保证与假设类中最好的假设接近, 如果假设类本身离真实函数很远 (偏差大), 学到的模型照样不好. 理论只控制「方差」这一部分.

Page 122–123

8.3.3 The case of infinite H

We have proved some useful theorems for the case of finite hypothesis classes. But many hypothesis classes, including any parameterized by real numbers (as in linear classification) actually contain an infinite number of functions. Can we prove similar results for this setting?

Let's start by going through something that is not the “right” argument. Better and more general arguments exist, but this will be useful for honing our intuitions about the domain.

Suppose we have an H that is parameterized by d real numbers. Since we are using a computer to represent real numbers, and IEEE double-precision floating point (double's in C) uses 64 bits to represent a floating point number, this means that our learning algorithm, assuming we're using double-precision floating point, is parameterized by 64d bits. Thus, our hypothesis class really consists of at most k=264d different hypotheses. From the Corollary at the end of the previous section, we therefore find that, to guarantee ε(h^)≤ε(h∗)+2γ, with to hold with probability at least 1 − δ, it suffices that n≥O(γ21​logδ264d​)=O(γ2d​logδ1​)=Oγ,δ​(d). (The γ, δ subscripts indicate that the last big-O is hiding constants that may depend on γ and δ.) Thus, the number of training examples needed is at most linear in the parameters of the model.

无限假设类: 实数参数化的假设类有无穷多个假设, log k 无意义. 先给一个「不太对」但很有启发的论证: 计算机里一个双精度数是 64 位, d 个参数共 64d 位, 所以最多 264d 个不同的假设; 代入推论, log k = 64d log 2, 所需样本数关于参数个数 d 是线性的.

讲义笔误: "with to hold with probability" 是残句, 多了 with; 另外 O(γ21​logδ264d​)=O(γ2d​logδ1​) 这一步不严格: 左边是 O(γ2d+log(1/δ)​), 写成乘积形式只是一个更松的上界 (δ 较小时成立), 不影响「关于 d 线性」的结论.

Page 123

The fact that we relied on 64-bit floating point makes this argument not entirely satisfying, but the conclusion is nonetheless roughly correct: If what we try to do is minimize training error, then in order to learn “well” using a hypothesis class that has d parameters, generally we're going to need on the order of a linear number of training examples in d.

(At this point, it's worth noting that these results were proved for an algorithm that uses empirical risk minimization. Thus, while the linear dependence of sample complexity on d does generally hold for most discriminative learning algorithms that try to minimize training error or some approximation to training error, these conclusions do not always apply as readily to discriminative learning algorithms. Giving good theoretical guarantees on many non-ERM learning algorithms is still an area of active research.)

The other part of our previous argument that's slightly unsatisfying is that it relies on the parameterization of H. Intuitively, this doesn't seem like it should matter: We had written the class of linear classifiers as hθ​(x)=1{θ0​+θ1​x1​+⋯θd​xd​≥0}, with n + 1 parameters θ0​,…,θd​. But it could also be written hu,v​(x)=1{(u02​−v02​)+(u12​−v12​)x1​+⋯(ud2​−vd2​)xd​≥0} with 2d + 2 parameters ui​,vi​. Yet, both of these are just defining the same H: The set of linear classifiers in d dimensions.

依赖 64 位浮点数让论证不够令人满意, 但结论大致正确: 用 ERM 学习一个有 d 个参数的假设类, 通常需要与 d 成线性的样本数. 这些结论是对 ERM 证明的; 对非 ERM 算法给出好的理论保证仍是研究课题. 另一个不令人满意之处: 论证依赖参数化方式. 同一族线性分类器, 可以用 d + 1 个参数写, 也可以用 2d + 2 个参数 (每个系数写成 u2−v2) 写, 按参数个数得到的界就差了一倍, 但假设类本身完全相同. 需要一个只依赖假设类本身的复杂度度量, 这就是 VC 维.

这个「离散化」论证的思路其实很有用: 把无限假设类近似成足够细的有限网格, 再用有限情形的界. 严格的证明 (覆盖数方法) 就是这个思路的精确版本.

讲义问题: ① 括号里的一句前后矛盾: 前半说结论对多数「判别式」算法成立, 后半又说不一定适用于「判别式」算法; 后者原意应是非 ERM 的算法 (或生成式算法). ② "with n + 1 parameters θ0​,…,θd​" 应为 d + 1 个参数.

Page 123–124

To derive a more satisfying argument, let's define a few more things.

Given a set S={x(i),…,x(D)} (no relation to the training set) of points x(i)∈X, we say that H shatters S if H can realize any labeling on S. I.e., if for any set of labels {y(1),…,y(D)}, there exists some h∈H so that h(x(i))=y(i) for all i = 1, …, D.

Given a hypothesis class H, we then define its Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension, written VC(H), to be the size of the largest set that is shattered by H. (If H can shatter arbitrarily large sets, then VC(H) = ∞.)

For instance, consider the following set of three points:

Can the set H of linear classifiers in two dimensions (h(x)=1{θ0​+θ1​x1​+θ2​x2​≥0}) can shatter the set above? The answer is yes. Specifically, we see that, for any of the eight possible labelings of these points, we can find a linear classifier that obtains “zero training error” on them:

打散: 一个点集 S (与训练集无关) 被假设类 H 打散, 是指对 S 的任意一种标注, 都有 H 中的某个假设恰好实现它. VC 维: H 能打散的最大点集的大小 (能打散任意大的点集则为 ∞). 例: 平面上的线性分类器能打散不共线的三个点, 因为 8 种标注都能用一条直线分开 (图中逐一画出).

打散的直观: 假设类的「表达力」够不够在这几个点上任意指定答案. 能打散的点越多, 说明假设类越能拟合任意标签 (包括纯噪声), 也就越可能过拟合, 所以 VC 维是复杂度的度量.

讲义笔误: 点集写成 {x(i),…,x(D)}, 应从 x(1) 开始; "Can the set H … can shatter" 中 can 重复.

Page 124–125

Moreover, it is possible to show that there is no set of 4 points that this hypothesis class can shatter. Thus, the largest set that H can shatter is of size 3, and hence VC(H) = 3.

Note that the VC dimension of H here is 3 even though there may be sets of size 3 that it cannot shatter. For instance, if we had a set of three points lying in a straight line (left figure), then there is no way to find a linear separator for the labeling of the three points shown below (right figure):

In order words, under the definition of the VC dimension, in order to prove that VC(H) is at least D, we need to show only that there's at least one set of size D that H can shatter.

任何 4 个点都打不散 (见下面的补充), 所以平面线性分类器的 VC 维是 3. 注意定义里是「存在一个大小为 D 的点集能被打散», 不要求所有点集都行: 共线的三点在 ×○× 标注下无法用直线分开, 但这不影响 VC 维为 3. 证明 VC 维 ≥ D 只需找到一个能打散的集合; 证明 VC 维 < D + 1 则要说明所有大小为 D + 1 的集合都打不散, 后者通常更难.

讲义笔误: "In order words" 应为 In other words.

为什么 4 个点打不散: 平面上 4 个点只有两种情况. ① 一个点在另外三点构成的三角形内 (或边上): 把这个点标 ○、三个顶点标 ×, 任何半平面若包含三个顶点就包含整个三角形, 不可能把中间的点排除. ② 四点构成凸四边形: 对角线两端标同一类 (××、○○ 交替), 两条对角线相交, 一条直线无法把它们分开 (这就是 XOR 问题). 一般地, d 维空间的线性分类器 (带截距) 的 VC 维是 d + 1, 恰好等于参数个数.

Page 125

The following theorem, due to Vapnik, can then be shown. (This is, many would argue, the most important theorem in all of learning theory.)

Theorem. Let H be given, and let D = VC(H). Then with probability at least 1 − δ, we have that for all h∈H,

∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣≤O(nD​logDn​+n1​logδ1​​).

Thus, with probability at least 1 − δ, we also have that:

ε(h^)≤ε(h∗)+O(nD​logDn​+n1​logδ1​​).

In other words, if a hypothesis class has finite VC dimension, then uniform convergence occurs as n becomes large. As before, this allows us to give a bound on ε(h) in terms of ε(h∗). We also have the following corollary:

Corollary. For ∣ε(h)−ε^(h)∣≤γ to hold for all h∈H (and hence ε(h^)≤ε(h∗)+2γ) with probability at least 1 − δ, it suffices that n=Oγ,δ​(D).

In other words, the number of training examples needed to learn “well” using H is linear in the VC dimension of H. It turns out that, for “most” hypothesis classes, the VC dimension (assuming a “reasonable” parameterization) is also roughly linear in the number of parameters. Putting these together, we conclude that for a given hypothesis class H (and for an algorithm that tries to minimize training error), the number of training examples needed to achieve generalization error close to that of the optimal classifier is usually roughly linear in the number of parameters of H.

Vapnik 定理 (很多人认为是学习理论中最重要的定理): VC 维为 D 时, 以 1 − δ 的概率, 所有 h 的训练误差与泛化误差之差不超过 O(nD​logDn​+n1​logδ1​​); 于是 ERM 的结果离最优不超过同样的量. 结论: VC 维有限, 就会一致收敛; 所需样本数与 VC 维成线性. 多数「合理参数化」的假设类 VC 维大致与参数个数成线性, 所以经验法则是: 所需样本数大致与参数个数成线性. 与有限情形对比: 那里的 log k 被 D (乘一个对数因子) 取代, VC 维扮演了「有效假设个数的对数」的角色.

常见假设类的 VC 维: d 维带截距的线性分类器: d + 1; 实数轴上的区间 [a, b] (区间内为 1): 2; 平面上轴平行的矩形: 4; sin(ωx) 的符号 (只有一个参数 ω): ∞. 最后一个例子说明 VC 维与参数个数并不总是一致: 一个参数也可以有无穷大的 VC 维, 这正是讲义说「合理参数化」的原因.

与 8.2 节的张力: 按这个经验法则, 参数远多于样本的深度网络不应泛化得好, 但实际上泛化得很好. 原因在于 VC 界是对整个假设类的最坏情况界, 不考虑优化算法实际找到的是哪个解; 隐式正则化让梯度下降只在假设类中「很小的一部分」里搜索, 有效复杂度远小于参数个数. 这正是 8.2 节说参数个数未必是好的复杂度度量的原因, 也是现代学习理论研究基于范数、间隔等的界的动机.
